beats.en: Numbers can be shown with tiles or blocks of hundreds, tens and ones. Eight hundred thirty-two is 8 hundreds, 3 tens and 2 ones. A number like 504 has 5 hundreds, no tens and 4 ones. The zero tells us there are no tens.
